pokedexEntries.bk: They have lightning-like movements. When Zebstrika run at full speed, the sound of thunder reverberates.

pokedexEntries.wh: This ill-tempered Pokémon is dangerous because when it’s angry, it shoots lightning from its mane in all directions.

pokedexEntries.b2w2: When this ill-tempered Pokémon runs wild, it shoots lightning from its mane in all directions.

pokedexEntries.sc: This Pokémon is aggressive and has a volatile disposition. When agitated, it will illuminate its mane in yellow and fire off bolts of electricity.

pokedexEntries.vi: Once the herd hears thunder, it chases after the storm clouds so that the Blitzle in the group can use the lightning to charge up.
